name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
author: HoverUI (https://hoverui.com)
description: The card turns up to eight degrees toward the cursor, with a specular sheen that travels against the turn. Keyboard focus lifts it without tilting; reduced motion holds it flat. Note: the component pins position, isolation and overflow:hidden on its own root, so content that must escape the card's bounds — popovers, tooltips, outside focus rings — will be clipped.
